eyebrow: Built for every seat at the table
heading: Whoever you are on the team, Helix has a workflow for you.
description: From solo founders to platform leads, Helix adapts the orchestration surface to the role that's holding the keyboard.

items.title: Solo founders
items.tagline: Ship like a team of five.
items.description: Turn late-night product ideas into reviewable diffs you can actually trust at 2am.
painPoints: No one to review the change
Big-bang commits that are hard to revert
Context switching between idea and PR

items.title: Staff engineers
items.tagline: Decompose the rewrite before you start it.
items.description: Plan a cross-cutting migration as a graph of safe atoms and ship it without breaking the build.

items.title: Engineering managers
items.tagline: Forecast scope, track atoms, unblock review.
items.description: See every in-flight change as a tile on a graph — with risk, owner, and review state surfaced at a glance.

items.title: Open-source maintainers
items.description: Convert a flood of issues into a queue of well-scoped PRs contributors can pick up safely.

items.title: Platform & DevEx teams
items.tagline: Standardize AI work across the org.
items.description: Codify review policy, conventions, and CI gates so every agent-driven PR meets the bar before review.

items.title: Product engineers
items.tagline: Prototype the feature, ship the polish.
items.description: Sketch a UX change in the morning and land the production-grade refactor in the afternoon — without a 2,000-line PR.
painPoints: Hard to share WIP with PMs
